title: What Should Data Teach? Moving Bottlenecks Across Circuit, Store, and Use
abstract: arXiv:2609.32991v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: What should data teach a language model at a particular point in training? A circuit view reveals three distinct bottlenecks: forming a computation, making its required content available, and selecting among available routes. A shared diagnosis-to-data principle connects them: localize the missing operation, preserve its causal relation, vary shortcut-bearing context, and re-audit the residual. Formation-sensitive selection and prerequisite ordering accelerate a binding-matching-transport path; a brief early prefix from the same training multiset retains a validation advantage through 100B tokens. Availability counterfactuals then distinguish writing content from invoking available memory, while paired supervision and context-opportunity ranking improve matched route decisions and long-context answer likelihood. translated_title: 数据应该教什么？——在电路、存储与使用之间移动瓶颈
translated_abstract: 在训练的特定阶段，数据应该教会语言模型什么？电路视角揭示了三个截然不同的瓶颈：形成一次计算、使其所需内容变得可用、以及在可用路径之间做出选择。一个统一的“诊断到数据”原则将三者联系起来：定位缺失的操作、保持其因果关系、变换含有捷径的上下文，并对残差进行重新审计。对“形成”敏感的数据选择与先修知识排序加速了“绑定—匹配—传输”路径；来自同一训练数据多重集的简短早期前缀在1000亿token范围内始终保持验证优势。随后，可用性反事实区分了“写入内容”与“调用已有记忆”，而配对监督与“上下文—机会”排序改善了匹配路径的决策以及长上下文回答的可能性。一个持续的3.5亿参数模型实验将三项干预联系在同一批事实上：早期电路训练改进了子……
tldr: 该论文提出以电路视角诊断语言模型训练中的三类数据瓶颈（计算形成、内容可用、路径选择），并给出统一的“诊断到数据”原则，通过形成敏感选择、可用性反事实与配对监督等针对性干预，显著提升了事实学习与长上下文问答能力。
en_tdlr: This paper adopts a circuit view to identify three distinct data-teaching bottlenecks in language model training—computation formation, content availability, and route selection—and proposes a unified diagnosis-to-data principle with targeted interventions (formation-sensitive selection, availability counterfactuals, and paired supervision) that improve fact learning and long-context answer likelihood.
